Qiuqiu: "Got the books... and bumped my head too, meow."
付 40 條押金，借一本坐在地上讀完（自選升級至多 2 張牌；押金不退）: Pay the 40 deposit, borrow one book, and read it through sitting on the floor (upgrade up to 2 cards of your choice; deposit is not refunded)
球球付了押金，抱著書坐在地上一頁一頁看。看到第二招時，眼皮越來越重——醒來時，書: Qiuqiu pays the deposit and sits on the floor hugging the book, reading page by page. By the second move, his eyelids grow heavier and heavier — and when he wakes, there's a puddle of drool on the book and the librarian is glaring at him. Still, he remembers those two moves perfectly. Qiuqiu: "No need to refund the deposit... I get it, meow."
在書架中間睡一覺（回復 16 點生命）: Take a nap between the bookshelves (recover 16 HP)
球球鑽到兩排書架中間，枕著一疊厚書睡著了。書庫又暗又安靜，只有管理員的鼾聲。醒來: Qiuqiu squeezes between two rows of shelves and falls asleep with a stack of thick books for a pillow. The library is dark and quiet, with only the librarian's snoring. When he wakes, a thin blanket, put there by who knows who, is draped over him. Qiuqiu: "It's even better for sleeping here than in the Cat Bed, meow."
塔中的廚房熱得像蒸籠。一群繫著小圍裙的飯糰怪排成一排，正把飯糰和醃魚塞進一個個便: The kitchen in the middle of the tower is as hot as a steamer. A row of Onigiri Monsters in little aprons is stuffing rice balls and pickled fish into bento boxes one by one, each lid labeled "Deliver Upstairs." The moment they see Qiuqiu, they all freeze in fright, one of them still holding a steaming rice ball. Qiuqiu: "...Smells so good, meow."
當場吃一個（回復 15 點生命）: Eat one on the spot (recover 15 HP)
球球拿起一個便當，當著牠們的面打開就吃。飯糰怪們面面相覷，最後有一隻小聲問：「…: Qiuqiu picks up a bento, opens it right in front of them, and starts eating. The Onigiri Monsters look at one another, and finally one asks in a small voice: "...Is it good?" His mouth stuffed full, Qiuqiu can only nod furiously. When he's done, he washes the empty box clean and returns it. Qiuqiu: "The pickled fish would be even better a bit saltier, meow."
包一個帶走（下一場戰鬥開始時獲得 2 點爪力與 8 點蜷縮）: Pack one to take with you (at the start of your next battle, gain 2 Claw and 8 Curl)
球球挑了一個最重的便當，用布包好繫在背上。飯糰怪們一起鞠躬，好像在說「路上小心」: Qiuqiu picks the heaviest bento, wraps it in cloth, and ties it on his back. The Onigiri Monsters all bow together, as if saying "Take care on the road." Qiuqiu: "I'll eat it right before a fight later, so my strength will be just right, meow."
捲起袖子幫牠們包便當（獲得 45 條小魚乾）: Roll up your sleeves and help them pack bento (get 45 Dried Fish)
球球捲起袖子，跟飯糰怪們一起包便當。牠包得又快又整齊，還在每個飯糰上捏了一對貓耳: Qiuqiu rolls up his sleeves and packs bento together with the Onigiri Monsters. He packs fast and neatly, and even pinches a pair of cat ears onto every rice ball. When the shift ends, the lead Onigiri Monster counts out forty-five Dried Fish for him. Qiuqiu: "Wait, who are these bento being sent to, meow?" The lead points at the ceiling: "The gatekeeper upstairs. The one for the very top comes back untouched every single day." Qiuqiu: "...Then I'll carry tomorrow's one up for you, meow."
一條長長的木造走廊，兩邊站滿了木人，每一個的手臂都接著齒輪。地上刻著一排腳印，旁: A long wooden corridor, with wooden dummies lined up on both sides, each with gears attached to its arms. A row of footprints is carved into the floor, with writing beside them: "Only those who can walk through have truly learned." The moment Qiuqiu takes a step forward, the nearest dummy swings out an arm with a click, nearly hitting his nose. On the wall is a board that looks like it can be lifted off, and from behind it comes the sound of gears turning. Qiuqiu: "It almost hit me in the face, meow!"
一口氣走過木人巷（最多失去 10 點生命；自選升級至多 2 張牌）: Walk through Wooden Dummy Alley in one go (lose up to 10 HP; upgrade up to 2 cards of your choice)
球球深吸一口氣衝進木人巷。左閃、右跳、低頭——還是被打中好幾下，頭上腫了一個包。: Qiuqiu takes a deep breath and dashes into the alley. Dodge left, hop right, duck — he still gets hit several times and ends up with a bump on his head. At the last dummy, its arm swings to within an inch of his nose and suddenly stops, and a little flag with a paw print on it pops up from the top of its head. Qiuqiu: "...Does this count as passing, meow?"
鑽到機關底下撿零件（隨機獲得 1 張罕見忍術牌、獲得 25 條小魚乾）: Crawl under the mechanism and pick up parts (get 1 random Uncommon Ninjutsu card, get 25 Dried Fish)
球球趴下來，從木人腳邊的縫鑽進機關底下。齒輪咬合的地方掉了一地零件，還有幾枚前人: Qiuqiu drops flat and crawls through the gap by the dummies' feet into the space under the mechanism. Parts litter the floor where the gears mesh, along with a few darts left by those who came before. He gathers an armful, and comes out with his headband smeared all over with machine oil. Qiuqiu: "The darts still work, and I'll sell the parts, meow."
掀開牆上的木板，關掉總開關（進入戰鬥；勝利後隨機獲得 1 件常見秘寶）: Lift the board off the wall and shut off the main switch (enter a battle; after winning, get 1 random Common Relic)
球球掀開木板，用力扳下總開關。整條走廊的木人一起停了下來——只有最裡面那一個，自: Qiuqiu lifts off the board and yanks the main switch down hard. Every dummy along the corridor stops at once — except the one at the far end, which turns around by itself and walks toward him. Qiuqiu: "Why are you the only one that didn't shut off, meow?"
塔頂的石台上躺著一顆會發光的石頭，還「滋滋」冒著熱氣，旁邊的石板燒出一個小坑。一: A glowing stone lies on the stone platform at the top of the tower, hissing and giving off heat, with a small pit burned into the slab beside it. An old bronze astrolabe has toppled over nearby, its pointer aimed at a constellation in the sky with one corner missing. The stone flickers on and off, as if panting. Qiuqiu: "A star... fell down, meow?"
撿起來帶走（最多失去 8 點生命；隨機獲得 1 件大魔物秘寶）: Pick it up and take it (lose up to 8 HP; get 1 random Elite Relic)
球球用頭巾包著手把星星撿起來，燙得左爪換右爪、右爪換左爪，一路甩到行囊邊才塞進去: Qiuqiu wraps his hand in his headband and picks up the star, so hot that he swaps it from his left paw to his right and back again, shaking it the whole way over to his pack before stuffing it in. Inside the bag, the star slowly cools, becoming a Relic that's warm to the touch. Qiuqiu: "It was burning hot... but now it's nice and warm, so comfy, meow."
用水澆涼，刮下一點星屑（自選升級至多 1 張牌、隨機獲得 1 個忍具）: Pour water on it to cool it and scrape off some stardust (upgrade up to 1 card of your choice, get 1 random Ninja Tool)
球球把水袋裡的水倒在星星上，「嘶」地冒出一大團白煙。星星涼了，表面浮著一層亮晶晶: Qiuqiu pours the water from his water pouch over the star, and with a hiss a big cloud of white steam bursts out. The star cools, a layer of glittering powder floating on its surface. He scrapes a little off and rubs it onto his claws, and when he strikes, his claw tips actually trail a streak of light; the rest he wraps into a small packet and stows. Qiuqiu: "This is shinier than Claw Powder, meow!"
把它丟回天上（生命上限與當前生命各 +9）: Throw it back into the sky (Max HP and current HP each +9)
球球抱起星星，憋足了氣往天上一丟。星星越飛越高，最後「叮」地一聲嵌回那個缺角的星: Qiuqiu picks up the star, takes a deep breath, and hurls it up into the sky. The star flies higher and higher, and finally snaps back into the constellation with the missing corner with a "ting," even blinking at him twice. A wash of warm light pours down onto him. Qiuqiu: "It's home, meow. ...I'll be home soon too, meow."
塔頂的長廊掛滿了風鈴，幾百個，大大小小。夜風一吹，全部一起響，吵得球球捂住耳朵。: The long corridor at the top of the tower is hung full of wind chimes, hundreds of them, big and small. When the night wind blows, they all ring at once, so loudly that Qiuqiu covers his ears. But after listening for a while, he realizes it isn't random ringing — the chimes come in waves, as if someone were performing moves: opening stance, step in, claw strike, closing stance. At the end of the corridor, one wind chime is mute, its clapper lying on the floor. Qiuqiu: "So noisy... but kind of nice to listen to, too, meow."
閉上眼睛聽完一整套（自選移除 1 張牌、回復 8 點生命）: Close your eyes and listen to the whole set (remove 1 card of your choice, recover 8 HP)
球球閉上眼睛，一動不動地聽。聽到第三輪，牠發現鈴聲裡有一段總是亂掉——正好是自己: Qiuqiu closes his eyes and listens without moving. By the third round, he notices that one section of the chimes always falls apart — and it's exactly the move he handles worst. He opens his eyes and decides to stop practicing it. Sitting and listening to the last gust of wind, his whole body relaxes too. Qiuqiu: "So that move of mine sounds this noisy, meow."
在風裡跟著鈴聲練步法（最多失去 6 點生命；自選升級至多 1 張牌、生命上限與當: Practice footwork to the chimes in the wind (lose up to 6 HP; upgrade up to 1 card of your choice, Max HP and current HP each +4)
球球跟著鈴聲在長廊裡來回走步，風大得好幾次把牠吹倒，臉頰也被風鈴甩到。走到最後一: Qiuqiu paces back and forth along the corridor to the chimes; the wind is strong enough to knock him down several times, and a swinging wind chime whacks his cheek. By the final round, his steps land exactly on the chimes' beat, and even his breathing falls into rhythm. Qiuqiu: "Walking with the wind is so much easier than walking against it, meow."
把那個啞掉的風鈴修好帶走（獲得秘寶「風鈴」；已經有的話改拿 60 條小魚乾）: Fix the mute wind chime and take it (get the Relic "Wind Chime"; if you already have it, get 60 Dried Fish instead)
球球找了一截細繩，把鈴舌綁回啞掉的風鈴，從掛勾上取下來。那一瞬間，整條長廊的風鈴: Qiuqiu finds a length of thin string, ties the clapper back into the mute wind chime, and takes it down from its hook. In that instant, every wind chime in the corridor falls silent. He takes a step forward, and the chime in his hand goes "ting" once; when he stops, it stops. Qiuqiu: "It only rings for me, meow."
石台的裂縫裡卡著一塊紫色的結晶，一明一暗，像在呼吸，四周的石頭都蒙上一層紫霜。球: A purple crystal is wedged in a crack in the stone platform, glowing and dimming as if breathing, the surrounding stones coated in a layer of purple frost. Just as Qiuqiu leans in, a low growl from Master echoes from the top of the tower — and the crystal flashes in time with the roar. He reaches out a claw, then pulls it back. Qiuqiu: "...Is this the thing inside Master, meow?"
把它收進懷裡（獲得「魔氣殘片」）: Tuck it against your chest (get "Miasma Shard")
球球咬著牙把結晶撿起來，塞進懷裡。胸口立刻一沉，像有什麼在輕輕拉著牠往上走。牠低: Gritting his teeth, Qiuqiu picks up the crystal and tucks it against his chest. His chest instantly feels heavy, as if something is gently pulling him upward. He looks down at the puddle on the platform, and the eyes in his reflection flash purple for a moment, then go dark. Qiuqiu hugs his pack tight and takes a step back. Qiuqiu: "This is the sound Master hears every day, meow..."
一擊把它敲碎（最多失去 8 點生命；自選移除 2 張牌）: Smash it with one blow (lose up to 8 HP; remove 2 cards of your choice)
球球一爪拍下去，結晶碎成一地紫色的砂，一股冷風猛地衝上來，把牠掀翻在地。等風散了: Qiuqiu slams a paw down and the crystal shatters into a scatter of purple sand; a blast of cold wind surges up and flips him onto the ground. When the wind clears, he climbs to his feet and finds that the two messiest moves in his head seem to have been blown away along with it. Qiuqiu: "It's smashed. ...If only the thing inside Master could be smashed in one blow like this, meow."
用布包起來，丟下塔（無效果）: Wrap it in cloth and throw it off the tower (no effect)
球球撕下一塊衣角，把結晶包了三層，走到欄杆邊用力丟下去。紫光在夜空裡越來越小，最: Qiuqiu tears off a corner of his clothing, wraps the crystal in three layers, walks to the railing, and hurls it down with all his strength. The purple light shrinks smaller and smaller in the night sky until it can't be seen anymore. Another low growl comes from the top of the tower, and this time nothing lights up with it. Qiuqiu: "Even one piece helps — one less is one less, meow."
只撐得住一個人的橋: A Bridge That Holds Only One
地牢中間裂開一道深溝，上面掛著一條爛木板吊橋。對岸石台上擺著一只刻著魔物紋的寶箱: A deep chasm splits the middle of the dungeon, with a rotten-plank suspension bridge hanging across it. On the stone platform on the far side sits a treasure chest carved with a monster crest. A rope is tied to a post at the bridgehead, with words carved beside it: "One at a time. Pull it taut before you cross." Qiuqiu steps on the first plank, and it sags downward with a creak. He looks back at {同伴}. Qiuqiu: "It only holds one, meow. {稱}, who's going across, meow?"
我過橋拿寶箱，{同伴}拉繩（我：隨機獲得 1 件大魔物秘寶；{同伴}：最多失去: I cross the bridge for the chest, {同伴} pulls the rope (Me: get 1 random Elite Relic; {同伴}: lose up to 10 HP)
球球踩著爛木板一路小跑過去，每一步都聽見{同伴}在後面拉緊繩子的悶哼聲。牠抱著寶: Qiuqiu jogs across the rotten planks, and with every step he hears the muffled grunts of {同伴} straining to hold the rope taut behind him. He runs back hugging the Relic from the chest, only then seeing that {同伴}'s hands have been rubbed raw by the rope. Qiuqiu: "...Next time I'll pull, meow. It's a promise, meow."
{同伴}過橋拿寶箱，我拉繩（{同伴}：隨機獲得 1 件大魔物秘寶；我：最多失去: {同伴} crosses the bridge for the chest, I pull the rope ({同伴}: get 1 random Elite Relic; Me: lose up to 10 HP)
球球雙腳抵住木樁，把繩子一圈圈纏在手上。{同伴}每往前一步，繩子就往溝裡扯一下，: Qiuqiu braces both feet against the post and winds the rope around his hands, turn after turn. With every step {同伴} takes forward, the rope yanks toward the chasm, rubbing Qiuqiu's paws until the skin breaks. Only when {同伴} returns hugging the Relic does Qiuqiu dare let go, slumping to the ground. Qiuqiu: "I held on, meow... my hands really hurt, but I held on, meow."
都不過橋，拆兩塊橋板去賣（兩人各獲得 30 條小魚乾）: Neither of you crosses; pull up two bridge planks and sell them (each of you gets 30 Dried Fish)
球球和{同伴}一起拆下橋頭兩塊還算完整的木板，扛去給樓梯口的舊貨攤，各換了三十條: Qiuqiu and {同伴} together pull up two of the still-decent planks at the bridgehead, haul them to the junk stall by the stairs, and each trade them for thirty Dried Fish. Qiuqiu glances back at the treasure chest. Qiuqiu: "Forget the chest... it matters more that we both come back in one piece, meow."
機關房中間有一座巨大的木頭翹翹板，一頭高高翹起，直頂到天花板旁的木架——架上擺著: In the middle of the mechanism room stands a giant wooden seesaw, one end tilted high up against a wooden shelf near the ceiling — on the shelf sit a cloth bundle and a small wooden box. The other end rests on the floor, with a paw print carved beside it that probably means "sit here." Qiuqiu looks at the shelf, then at {同伴}. Qiuqiu: "When one of us sits down, the other goes up, meow. {稱}, do you want to go up or down, meow?"
我坐上去拿架上的東西，{同伴}在下面壓著（我：隨機獲得 1 件常見秘寶與 1 個: I ride up to grab what's on the shelf, {同伴} weighs down the other end (Me: get 1 random Common Relic and 1 Ninja Tool; {同伴}: upgrade up to 1 card of your choice, get 30 Dried Fish)
{同伴}在下面一坐，球球「咻」地被抬上去，差點撞到天花板。牠抓住木架，把布包和小: The moment {同伴} sits down below, Qiuqiu is whisked upward with a whoosh, nearly hitting the ceiling. He grabs the shelf, hugs the cloth bundle and the small wooden box to his chest, and waves down. Qiuqiu: "So high, meow! {稱}, lower me down slowly, meow — slowly, meow!"
{同伴}坐上去拿，我在下面壓著（{同伴}：隨機獲得 1 件常見秘寶與 1 個忍具: {同伴} rides up to grab it, I weigh down the other end ({同伴}: get 1 random Common Relic and 1 Ninja Tool; Me: upgrade up to 1 card of your choice, get 30 Dried Fish)
球球一屁股坐上低的那頭，{同伴}就被抬了上去。等{同伴}在上面翻東西，牠無聊地摸: Qiuqiu plops down on the low end, and {同伴} is lifted up. While {同伴} rummages through things up top, Qiuqiu, bored, feels around under the seesaw and pulls out a small bag of Dried Fish that someone dropped; then he practices a few moves next to the pivot, and finds that turning in time with the seesaw's rhythm feels smoothest. Qiuqiu: "It's not bad down here — there's Dried Fish to pick up, meow."
